title: Bound and determinize local ICS file and vdir ingestion
description:
## Finding

Local ICS ingestion has no byte, time, file-type, or aggregate-allocation boundary, and its nominal file cap selects the wrong entries nondeterministically.

A single configured file and every selected vdir entry are read with `read_to_string` before parsing. There is no per-file or total-byte limit, and `max_events` is enforced only after every document has been read and every event allocated. A symlinked `.ics` entry can target a FIFO/device or arbitrary growing file, so a read can block indefinitely. Directory-entry errors are silently discarded.

The loop applies `.take(20_000)` **before** filtering for `.ics`. Filesystem enumeration order is unspecified, so 20,000 unrelated entries can hide every valid calendar; different runs/filesystems can ingest different subsets. Even when all entries are valid, 20,000 large files can consume unbounded memory/CPU. The synchronous filesystem and parsing work runs directly inside an async backend future on the current-thread calendar runtime, serializing the whole account pass and occupying a bounded background-lane permit for an unbounded duration.

## Evidence at audited commit

* `crates/thegn-svc/src/calendar/ics.rs:18-19,48-84`: advisory count cap only; unbounded reads; errors flattened; cap precedes extension filter.
* `ics.rs:97-117`: synchronous work executes inside `Box::pin(async move { ... })`; event truncation occurs only after all work.
* `crates/thegn-core/src/calendar/ics.rs:27-45,154-220`: parsing unfolds the complete input into allocated strings before event parsing.
* `crates/thegn-svc/src/calendar/mod.rs:204-233`: all later accounts wait for this one.
* `crates/thegn-host/src/hydrate_calendar.rs:125-203`: the router runs on a new current-thread runtime inside one background job, so blocking cannot be cancelled by async deadlines.

## Required design

Define a bounded local-source reader with an explicit regular-file/symlink policy. Enumerate deterministically, inspect and validate file type without following an attacker-swappable pathname where supported, count eligible calendar files rather than arbitrary directory entries, and surface scan/read errors and truncation explicitly.

Apply configurable hard caps to per-file bytes, aggregate bytes, eligible files, content lines, and parsed events before allocation growth. Stop parsing/enumeration once the accepted budget is exhausted while preserving recurrence-master correctness. Execute blocking I/O/parser work on an owned bounded blocking lane with cancellation and a total deadline; do not let FIFOs/devices or replacement races create unbounded reads.

## Acceptance criteria

- [ ] Single-file and directory sources enforce per-file and aggregate byte ceilings before growing buffers.
- [ ] Only eligible regular calendar files count toward the file cap.
- [ ] Enumeration and truncation are deterministic across runs.
- [ ] Entry/read/metadata failures are bounded, surfaced per account, and do not silently change which subset is authoritative.
- [ ] Symlinks, FIFOs, devices, sparse/growing files, replaced paths, invalid UTF-8, and permission errors have explicit tested policy.
- [ ] `max_events` and parser budgets stop upstream reading/parsing rather than truncating only the final vector.
- [ ] Cancellation and a total deadline release the blocking worker and calendar synchronization permit.
- [ ] Large-file/vdir tests prove bounded resident memory, CPU, handles, and wall time.
- [ ] Partial ingestion cannot be mistaken for a complete authoritative snapshot.

## Dependency mapping

The source-budget implementation is independent of <issue id="37123fdd-5d17-41e6-a3d7-822c165d706f" href="https://linear.app/blakeashley/issue/THE-450/separate-calendar-resource-series-and-recurrence-instance-identity">THE-450</issue>/<issue id="03224068-8a1f-413d-87fb-65b45fd6c833" href="https://linear.app/blakeashley/issue/THE-451/commit-calendar-pages-tombstones-and-sync-cursors-atomically">THE-451</issue> identity and transaction design, but its explicit partial/completeness result must integrate with <issue id="0983c521-7456-4ce7-b924-6ef073009447" href="https://linear.app/blakeashley/issue/THE-452/separate-calendar-page-mode-from-the-returned-sync-cursor">THE-452</issue> page modes. It should be complete before account-level parallel synchronization is enabled so concurrency cannot multiply unbounded local reads.
